label: GO step after a rewarded trial, early in the episode only (an a2-leaning signal that fades out)
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass), and almost only when the previous trial was rewarded (99.6% of mass). It never fires at D1 or D2, and never after trial 40 of an episode: its rate is 6% in trials 0-9 and falls to 0 by trial 40-49. The predicate GO & prev_reward==1 & ep_trial<40 covers 96% of activations and 99.5% of the mass on dev, but precision is only 0.11, so the unit fires on just a subset of those steps. Within that subset, 86% of the mass falls on steps where the agent chooses a2 (model_act 2, strong a2 policy logit). Example windows suggest the activation is largest on the first rewarded trial after an unrewarded one and decays over a run of rewards (0.98, then 0.70, then 0.19). Requiring the trial before the previous one to be unrewarded raises precision only to about 0.2-0.3 and costs recall. No observed variable I tried (reward history, choice, value bins) gives high precision. The unit looks like a slowly drifting early-episode transient gated by previous reward at GO, not a clean task variable. All variables in the predicate are observed.
